svg.title: A signal is not a transported molecule
svg.desc: An intentionally hypothetical signalling example. A ligand associates with an extracellular receptor domain. The receptor is shown at a membrane boundary. A proposed intracellular activation leads to a generic effector, while a second proposed relation inhibits the effector. Dashed relationships are illustrative, not an asserted named pathway.

text.tspan: A signal is not a transported molecule
House notation separates association, activation and inhibition
Illustrative mechanism only; not a named pathway or evidence of molecular binding. Dashed lines denote hypothetical
relationships. Open arrow: activation. T-bar: inhibition. Plain line: association.
